questions.question: What was Disney’s first feature-length animated film?
questions.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
questions.note: 1937 — nicknamed “Disney’s Folly” before it became a hit.

questions.question: In Finding Nemo, what kind of fish is Nemo?
questions.note: Dory is a blue tang; the anemone is home.

questions.question: Who is credited with creating Mickey Mouse, along with Ub Iwerks?
What Pixar film is set inside a young girl’s mind, with characters like Joy and Sadness?
questions.note: Riley’s headquarters; Bing Bong is her imaginary friend.

questions.question: In Shrek, who voices the talking Donkey?
questions.note: Mike Myers is Shrek; Cameron Diaz is Princess Fiona.

questions.question: Which 1994 Disney film includes the song “Hakuna Matata”?
Which studio made Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature film?
questions.note: 1995, released by Disney; Woody and Buzz Lightyear.

questions.question: In Frozen, what is Elsa’s sister’s name?
questions.note: Kristoff, Sven, and Olaf round out the poster.

questions.question: What 2007 Pixar film is about a rat who dreams of becoming a chef in Paris?
questions.note: Remy and Linguini; the critic is Anton Ego.

questions.question: What is the name of the green ogre voiced by Mike Myers?
questions.note: The first film won the first Oscar for Best Animated Feature, in 2002.
